digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and datetime timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ checks are not currently enabled in the global configuration despite three DTZ violations existing in production code at specific lines.

Validation timestamp semantics must explicitly handle timezone information: integer epoch seconds converted with UTC timezone and timezone-less persisted strings assigned UTC timezone before clustering.
Timezone handling implementation must be proven invariant under multiple TZ environment settings on POSIX/macOS platforms via time.tzset() testing.

Security-pin cadence logic must preserve host-local calendar-date semantics by obtaining an aware current instant with explicit timezone argument and converting to host timezone before extracting date.
Production code must use datetime.timezone.utc for all UTC construction and prohibit the datetime.UTC token due to py310 target version constraint.
